title: Rope Ladders
description: Enables downward ladder placement and chain destruction
body:
Ladders can now be extended downward in a chain, regardless of support. When a hanging part is broken, everything below it shatters and the items are teleported to the top for easy pickup.

![Ladders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e6abe42f72b9a4c4e5f65ef84b6e57b9e249553_0.webp)

Inspired by [Rope Ladders](https://modrinth.com/datapack/gm4-rope-ladders)
